summary: Non-Invasive Monitoring Systems filed an 8-K reporting fifth amendments to four related-party promissory notes dated September 29, 2026. Each note carries a $75,000 principal balance owed to Frost Gamma Investments Trust, controlled by director Dr. Phillip Frost, and to Chairman/Interim CEO Dr. Jane Hsiao, both beneficial owners exceeding 10% of common stock. Only the maturity dates were extended from September 30, 2026 to October 31, 2026; no other provisions changed. This is a routine debt-maturity extension, not a special situation. Watch for further short-dated extensions or liquidity strain given repeated amendments.
